units.source_text: 此次薰大将与浮舟比往日更觉难分难舍，

en.t: This time, General Kaoru found it even harder than before to part from Ukifune,
He wanted to stay there for several days.

units.source_text: 但念世人物议，实甚可虑。

en.t: But when he thought of the gossip people would spread, it was truly a serious concern.

units.source_text: 不久便可长聚，今日何必贪欢。

en.t: Before long they would be able to stay together, so why cling greedily to today's pleasure?

units.source_text: 便回心转意，于破晓时分启程返京。

en.t: So he changed his mind and set out for the capital at daybreak.

units.source_text: 一路上回想浮舟此次忽然变成大人模样，对她的挂念比往日更深了。

en.t: On the way, as he recalled how Ukifune had suddenly seemed grown-up this time, his longing for her became deeper than ever.
